title: 각 메뉴의 검색기간 기본값을 변경하는 방법

lookup.publicWebSearch: Focused official-domain query returned no relevant result; unrelated search results excluded

staticFindings.name: date_range_condition_default_value
staticFindings.finding: Generic initializer returns type:range and from_date/to_date:null. This is not proof of a purchase menu period, a saved preference, or the runtime initial dates.

staticFindings.name: getPresetSearchDataKeys
staticFindings.finding: Preset search data collects props excluding display_state:false and includes selectable-group target props, then deduplicates. This is not proof that a specific date field is included in a real purchase preset.

staticFindings.name: collectPresetSearchDataWithDefaultsAsync
staticFindings.finding: Collects current DMC values and calls DataModelInitializerByDataTypeProgram for missing values; no per-user/company writer or relative-date resolver is included.

existingOperatingBehavior: Without a configured search form default, docFilters initializes Jan1 through today.
configureGrid applies nonempty saved search-form field defaults on fresh setup; FormCore.defaultValue resolves @today or a fixed literal. This existing feature is preserved.
Retained request/report work tabs keep pending/applied search values, quick text, errors and scroll as transient state. This is distinct from saved period defaults.
remainingGates: Exact033 full manual and read-only actual purchase/menu setting editor, including labels, selected values and setting route.
Actual saved metadata and writer: company/user/role/menu/template scope, precedence and permission validation; no assumption that a generic saved search preset is the date-default setting.
Supported fixed/relative dates, business date/timezone and week/month/year boundary rules; blank/unset/reset behavior.
New screen vs retained work tab vs close/reopen/relogin behavior; preserve pending search draft and applied results.
Original read-only contracts and synthetic configured save/cancel/permission/preservation acceptance before app integration and hosted setting acceptance.
